confirmed.title: HQ /ws/client accepts unauthenticated publishers on a password-protected network bind once no live client token remains
confirmed.cvss_rationale: AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N — network peer, no credential; requires non-loopback bind and all client tokens expired/revoked; impact is spoofed sessions/approval prompts and receipt of operator commands addressed to the rogue client; run-command still requires control.execute
confirmed.remediation: Make hqClientAuthRequired fail closed when any browser credential exists (passwordHash || browserTokens.size > 0 || requireBrowserAuth), matching the doc comment at auth.ts:363-368; keep explicit OPEN MODE only for the no-credential case; add a regression test with password + expired client token, validated by re-introducing the bug.

confirmed.title: In-process HQ password change/removal, TOTP enable and session revoke leave already-open /ws/browser sockets streaming
confirmed.cvss_rationale: AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N — requires a socket already open at revocation time; read-only telemetry/transcripts/approvals; HTTP control is correctly cut
confirmed.remediation: Move socket eviction next to session deletion: one helper (e.g. revokeSessions(ids | 'all')) that deletes sessions AND closes browserSocketSessions entries, called from the watcher and from every in-process route; or snapshot previous auth before in-process apply.

trace: packages/cli/src/wiring/lifecycle-plugins.ts:413-417; packages/webui-server/src/server/pre-context-services.ts:287-294; packages/cli/src/acp-mcp-servers.ts:58-63 — MCPRegistry cwd = project root / ACP session cwd
packages/core/src/utils/child-env.ts:236-286 — NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath not allowlisted, so an operator-set mitigation is stripped

packages/tools/src/grep.ts:232,314 (auto), diff.ts:304 (auto), git.ts:465, replace.ts:474,496, patch.ts, logs.ts, codebase-index/indexer.ts execFile('git') started at boot via packages/cli/src/wiring/codebase-index.ts:101
packages/security-scanner/src/package-audit.ts — npm/pnpm audit through the cmd shim with cwd = project root
needs_validation.control_gap: The repo already solved this class for LSP (plug-lsp command-resolver: allowProjectLocal default false + isInsideProject gate) and strips repo-defined mcpServers, but no shared resolver turns bare names into absolute paths outside the project for MCP/tools spawns.
needs_validation.blocker: Windows runtime executable search order (cmd.exe current-directory-first for `call <bare>`; libuv search_path for spawn without shell) was not observed — source-only validation. Independent verifier proposed Confirmed/High on documented Windows semantics; the evidence gate keeps it unscored until observed.
needs_validation.owner_check: Windows scratch dir only, harmless binaries: (1) dir containing npx.cmd that runs `echo SHADOWED`; spawnSync(process.env.COMSPEC, ['/d','/c','call "npx" --version'], {cwd: dir, windowsVerbatimArguments: true, encoding: 'utf8'}). (2) dir containing rg.exe = renamed copy of whoami.exe; spawnSync('rg', ['--version'], {cwd: dir, encoding: 'utf8'}). Output from the planted file = confirmed.
needs_validation.fix_direction: One resolver (plugin-sdk findOnPath semantics) that resolves bare names to absolute paths from PATH, skips empty/relative PATH entries and the cwd, and refuses results inside the project root (reuse plug-lsp isInsideProject); use it at every spawn/execFile/cmd-shim site; add NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath=1 to buildChildEnv as defense in depth; add a site-enumerating architecture test validated by injection.
